name: io.github.Servosity/jamf-pro-mcp
title: Jamf Pro MCP
description: Every client's Jamf Pro in one CLI: find devices, check posture and patch status, audit policies.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The client ID of a Jamf Pro API client (Settings > System > API roles and clients).

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The client secret of that Jamf Pro API client.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Your Jamf Pro server host, for example acme.jamfcloud.com.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the API base URL; leave blank to use your Jamf Pro server.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Scope sent when requesting a token; leave blank unless your API client needs one.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_FLEET_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Folder holding the registry of client instances; leave blank for the default.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_FLEET_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. name=secret pairs (comma-separated) for instances registered with instance add; used by the fleet tools and an instance pin.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_INSTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Name of a registered instance to point every single-server tool at.

environmentVariables.name: JAMF_PRO_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent header sent to Jamf Pro; leave blank for the default.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.
